Title: ClickFix - js-static.cfd fake Cloudflare verification host
Description: Domain injected into compromised websites; serves fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA (embed.js, c.js, /api/s/*, /api/track/event) that copies a malicious command to the clipboard. Targets Windows and macOS. Source: SANS ISC diary 33466 (Brad Duncan, 2026-10-28) https://isc.sans.edu/diary/33466
RecommendedActions: Isolate host if user ran a pasted command; review Run/Terminal history, browser history, and child processes of explorer.exe/Terminal.
